paragraphs.source_en: This wandering monk was Zuifū, a monk from Mount Hiei. Bold and uninhibited by nature, he delighted in lofty discourse and had once declared that he would carry on the Buddha’s great work and travel through all the provinces. Hearing Hatarō’s question to Kyūroku, he gave a scornful laugh. “The Mizuno clan is still bound by worldly affections.”
